frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/portfolio-performance/pages/PortfolioDashboardPage.tsx:226-227 — the per-alert actions are fired as `onMarkRead={() => markRead.mutate(alert.id)}` and `onResolve={() => resolve.mutate(alert.id)}` with NO `onError` callback, no second-arg options object, and no surfacing of `markRead.isError` / `resolve.isError` anywhere in the render tree (the hooks are `useMarkAlertRead`/`useResolveAlert` at :141-142). If the mutation rejects (network/5xx/permission), the failure is swallowed: the alert row stays in its old state, no toast/inline error is shown, and the user has no signal their mark-read/resolve did not persist. On a reload the alert reappears, making it look like the action silently reverted.

Severity MEDIUM (+2): unhandled error on a user-facing mutation path (stale UI + silent data-state divergence, no user feedback). Confidence MEDIUM: statically certain no error path is wired at the call site; not high because exact UX impact depends on the generated hook's retry/toast defaults (none are configured here). Fix: pass `{ onError }` to show a toast/inline error, or render `markRead.isError`/`resolve.isError`.
